title: japan-holidays-rokuyo-business-days-2026: Japan National Holidays, JST Rokuyo & Business Days Dataset & Engine
description: Open structured reference datasets (JSON/CSV) for Japan Cabinet Office national holidays (2024-2028), JST (UTC+9) astronomical lunar new moons (2019-2033), Rokuyo, Tenshanichi/Ichiryumanbaibi lucky days, and zero-dependency ESM business-day calculation formulas published by HizukeKeisanJP (hizukekeisan.com). Interactive browser calculator (free, no registration): https://hizukekeisan.com/
